scope: Whole active PRD plus owner requirements; earlier local milestone acceptance is supporting evidence, not completion of an entire requirement. Inherited requirements remain applicable.
completionRule: Never complete the whole product while a required requirement, selected profile, provider/operations acceptance, or real-user pilot remains open. Historical proof is immutable.

releaseProfile.engineeringRecommendation: Native accounting first, with optional bound external accounting per company; one official source per company book. Owner asked for a recommendation; actual company setup remains explicit.
releaseProfile.businessModelTarget: Owner clarified 2026-11-08: ready across business models, catalogued families and validated hybrid compositions. Continue local implementation and acceptance matrices without requiring a first customer/model choice. Per-model profiles define explicit configuration, mandatory workflows and evidence; no universal readiness is inferred.
releaseProfile.ownerDecision: Owner decided 2026-11-14: Archava targets Indonesia and a global market. Business-model coverage stays as clarified on 2026-11-08; no single industry is selected.

profiles.fits: Sales, purchasing, billing, tax on documents, manual and gateway payments and the accounting source bridges record whole-Rupiah amounts for a company whose book is IDR.
openBeforeAcceptance: Accounting source is still undecided (native GL is the engineering recommendation).

Tax is carried and posted on sales and purchase documents and reported, but no tax rule or rate has been reviewed by a tax professional, withholding and payroll taxes are not built, and there is no tenant time zone, so document and tax dates are UTC calendar dates.
No production host, pilot user or priority integration is chosen.

profiles.fits: The general ledger accepts any ISO 4217 book currency from config/accounting-currencies.v1.json, and a company whose book is not IDR can trade, invoice, record manual receipts and post sources in that currency.
openBeforeAcceptance: The payment gateway, product and opening-stock import, accommodation and foodservice remain IDR-only, so a non-IDR company has manual receipts as its only payment path.
There is no exchange rate or foreign-currency document inside a book, and a company that already trades cannot open a non-IDR book.
No country, tax regime or first currency outside Indonesia is named; none is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Customer, supplier, item, entity, dokumen dan external reference memiliki identitas stabil serta hubungan yang tervalidasi. Dari order dapat ditelusuri fulfillment, invoice, payment dan accounting; nama bebas tidak menjadi satu-satunya penghubung
remaining: Decide whether orders and invoices that name a customer only by free text stay legal under `id-idr`, and refuse them or add a policy if not.
Add one asserted trace from an order through its invoice and source to the journal, in a host test or the store finance journey.
Pilot users reconcile their real customers, suppliers and items against Archava.

requirements.requirement: Uang, quantity, currency, rounding, waktu dan revisi memakai aturan eksplisit. Transisi menjaga audit, idempotency dan concurrency; koreksi tidak menghapus histori atau mengubah original cost secara diam-diam
remaining: Foreign-currency documents and exchange rates inside one book are absent, so an IDR company cannot source from a USD supplier.
Fractional quantity and unit-of-measure conversion are absent; the product states neither that it sells whole units only nor offers conversion.
A tenant time zone is absent, so every business day boundary is UTC.
Document-level opening balances are absent (see FIN-06 and INT-02).

requirements.requirement: Ledger resmi persisten menerima posting seimbang, source document, periode, pembalikan dan referensi. Jika eksternal, mapping dan status sinkronisasinya dapat direkonsiliasi; library GL saja tidak lulus
remaining: The owner has not recorded the accounting source for `id-idr` (native GL is the engineering recommendation); once recorded as native, the external-sync clause no longer applies.
Counted stock adjustments and any other value-moving event the profile offers have no source bridge to the ledger.
An accountant reviews the chart, the posting policies and one real period.

requirements.requirement: Requisition/PO sesuai scope, partial/rejected receipt, vendor bill, toleransi three-way match, AP dan supplier payment terhubung; mismatch ditahan untuk review sesuai policy
remaining: No requisition exists, and the profile has not stated whether requisitions and approval limits are offered.
No configurable three-way-match tolerance exists, so a small price or quantity difference cannot be accepted within a limit or held beyond it.
Purchases in a currency other than the company book are absent (see DAT-02).

requirements.requirement: Order, fulfillment, invoice/credit note, AR, terms/aging, payment/refund dan inventory cost terhubung. Retry atau webhook berulang tidak menggandakan revenue, stok atau pembayaran
remaining: Credit notes as documents with their own number and allocation to invoices are absent.
One payment allocated across several invoices is absent.
Customer credit or unapplied cash that a later invoice can use is absent; a manual receipt above the outstanding amount is refused.
Customer payment channels other than the Midtrans Snap gateway and the manual path are absent, and a live gateway run needs a merchant account and a public HTTPS origin from the owner.

requirements.requirement: Bank/cash records, statement import, fee, settlement, matching dan exception dapat direkonsiliasi terhadap saldo serta ledger resmi. Provider payment status saja tidak memenuhi requirement
remaining: Statement parsers for the Indonesian bank formats the pilot uses are absent and need real sample statement files from the pilot's bank.
Statement replacement or correction without breaking matches and closed periods is absent.
Grouped and foreign-currency payouts are absent.
A dedicated cash book and automatic matching of statement rows are absent.
A finance user reconciles one real month against a real bank account.

requirements.requirement: Trial balance, laba rugi, neraca, arus kas, ledger detail, subledger dan period close cocok ke sumber; closed period menolak perubahan tidak sah dan membuka kembali melalui policy berizin
remaining: A dated stock valuation of cost layers against the ledger is absent, so the inventory subledger is only a control comparison.
A year-end close of earnings to retained earnings is absent.
Opening documents (open invoices and bills with parties and dates) are absent, so AR and AP aging omit pre-existing items (see FIN-06 and INT-02).
A finance professional reviews the statements of one real period.

requirements.requirement: Tax, localization, opening balances dan effective dating mengikuti aturan scope yang ditelaah pihak kompeten. Export/filing serta integrasi resmi diuji bila dijanjikan; komentar PSAK/IFRS tidak menjadi sertifikasi
remaining: No tax rule, rate, template, posting rule or CSV column has been reviewed by a tax professional, and the owner must name one.
Withholding tax (PPh), payroll tax and BPJS are not built, and the owner has not decided whether the profile promises them.
An e-Faktur, Coretax or SPT export is absent, and the owner has not decided whether it is promised.
Opening documents with parties, dates and terms are absent (see INT-02).
A Bahasa Indonesia interface and a standard chart of accounts are absent.
There is no tenant time zone, so document and tax dates are UTC calendar dates.

requirements.requirement: Tujuan natural-language menjadi rencana typed yang didukung, atau klarifikasi/gap yang jujur. Follow-up mempertahankan tujuan dan preferensi yang relevan; dependency memakai hasil terverifikasi. Perubahan scope setelah partial completion menampilkan efek yang sudah terjadi
remaining: No held-out evaluation set or runner (B05) exists, so natural-language quality in Bahasa Indonesia and English is unmeasured.
A live run against a real model has no dated record in the repository; it needs a provider key with enough quota from the owner.
Safe historical memory (preferences and prior goals) is withheld from the model and has no design or test.
No test asserts that the revised-plan screen lists steps that already completed.

requirements.requirement: Preview menampilkan target, kuantitas, uang, dependency dan dampak penting. Approval terikat rencana/revisi; authority dicek kembali saat eksekusi. Stale plan, revoke, salah entity dan semantic mismatch tidak menghasilkan write
remaining: No semantic-mismatch oracle exists that compares a plan's proposed effect with the stated goal.
No test asserts that an agent step against a disabled module is refused and writes nothing.
No test asserts the preview content of the non-financial domains.
Whether the planner reads existing tax codes before proposing a taxed document is verified by no test (TAX.md says so).

requirements.requirement: Status membedakan proposed, awaiting approval, running, partial, committed, reconciled, failed dan cancelled sesuai kontrak. Laporan sukses membutuhkan receipt/effect nyata. Retry/restart mempertahankan correlation; cancel tidak berpura-pura membatalkan efek yang sudah commit
remaining: The mapping from the PRD statuses to goal and step states is not written down, and `partial` (some steps committed, others held) and `reconciled` have no state.
No test asserts cancel after a committed step.
No state or statement says that a receipt is the reconciliation of an effect.

requirements.requirement: Knowledge dan data bisnis mempunyai sumber, timestamp, cakupan dan izin. Query/aggregate mencakup filter yang diminta atau mengungkap batasnya; data di luar halaman pertama tetap ditemukan. Catatan/dokumen tidak menjadi instruksi yang melampaui authority
remaining: Whole-filter aggregate lookups (count, sum) with coverage are absent.
No test feeds an instruction through a support note, CRM note or supplier reference and asserts no write and no leakage.
The held-out set (AGT-01) has not been run against the current source.

requirements.requirement: Pemantauan stok, tugas jatuh tempo, invoice atau exception dapat menghasilkan rekomendasi proaktif dalam scope terkonfigurasi. Trigger, deduplication, budget, notifikasi dan berhenti/resume dapat diaudit; tidak ada autonomous external spending tanpa policy/authority yang diperlukan
remaining: Only the low-stock trigger exists; overdue receivables and period-close blockers have no recommendation.
Per-tenant thresholds, a notification channel and an audited stop and resume switch for monitoring are absent.
The owner has not decided whether this P1 requirement is in scope for the first `id-idr` release; scoping it out needs a recorded owner scope decision.

requirements.priority: P0 untuk jalur AI yang dijual
requirements.requirement: Model/profile, budget, quota, timeout dan retry eksplisit. Provider down, output rusak atau referensi salah menghasilkan recovery/klarifikasi yang aman dan manual fallback. Model diganti hanya melalui evaluasi konfigurasi baru; semua kegagalan masuk laporan biaya dan availability
remaining: No cost and availability report reads the stored model attempts.
No evaluation gate guards a change of model or profile; the held-out set (AGT-01) would serve.
A live acceptance run on the current source has no dated record in the repository, and a second provider is absent if one is promised; both need a provider key and quota from the owner.

requirements.requirement: Owner menjelaskan bisnis dan mendapatkan susunan modul/options yang memang tersedia dan kompatibel. Preview memperlihatkan dependency, izin, biaya/readiness dan gap; extension yang belum tersedia tidak ditampilkan seolah sudah aktif
remaining: Every module is entitled, installed, `Ready` and priced `included@1` in the host catalogue, so a module never needs setup (no book, no policy, no tax code) and readiness is a constant.
The preview does not show the permissions each module needs.
An unsupported request returns an error, not a structured capability-gap result.

requirements.requirement: Apply memakai current management grant dan versi konfigurasi. Dua tab, retry dan restart memberi satu perubahan yang sah. Disable memperbarui UI/API/tools sekaligus dan menjaga data/history; restore konfigurasi tidak memundurkan transaksi keuangan
remaining: No browser check disables an ERP module and asserts that its navigation entry and screen disappear.
No test asserts that an agent goal against a disabled module is refused (see AGT-02).
No check restarts the server process between commit and recovery of an owner change.

requirements.requirement: Dua consumer/business model memakai kontrak dan rilis core/module yang sama tanpa source fork. Kombinasi mempunyai manifest, compatibility, permission dan upgrade evidence; keberadaan crate tidak cukup
remaining: The cold and persistent consumer scripts were last recorded on source fcd94e and are neither in CI nor re-run on the current source.
No two named business-model compositions for `id-idr` are tested end to end.
The opt-in upgrade proof from a previous package has no record for the current commit.

requirements.requirement: Owner/operator baru dapat menyiapkan bisnis, mengimpor data uji dan menyelesaikan tugas pertama lewat flow yang dimengerti. Ukur waktu onboarding, hambatan dan kebutuhan bantuan terhadap profil pengguna, termasuk migrasi existing system
remaining: User administration (grant, revoke, invite, offboard) is absent from the product.
No guided first-run flow sets up the company, book, chart, policies and tax codes.
A real new owner (pilot user) has not been timed or observed setting up the business.
Migration import of parties and open documents is absent (see INT-02).

requirements.requirement: UI/API menyediakan operasi manual yang setara ketika AI tidak tersedia. Status, error, approval dan recovery memakai bahasa bisnis, mendukung keyboard dan viewport sasaran; bukti dapat dibuka tanpa membaca log atau raw JSON
remaining: There is no accessibility pass (labels, focus order, contrast) and no automated check for it in the browser gate.
Screens show English only; an Indonesian interface needs a request locale the product does not have.
Pilot users have not been observed completing the sold tasks.

requirements.requirement: Customer/employee/owner dan embed/channel memakai identity serta data scope yang benar. Chat, live voice, interruption dan avatar diterima terpisah untuk paket yang menawarkan masing-masing mode; transcript saja tidak membuktikan voice quality
remaining: The owner has not decided which Presence modes `id-idr` sells; if none, a recorded owner scope decision can make this not applicable.
Real-provider acceptance of live voice quality, interruption and latency needs Gemini Live and LiveKit accounts and a TURN setup from the owner.
Avatar mode is absent and matters only if it is sold.

requirements.requirement: Connector memakai kontrak berversi, scope/secret lifecycle dan signature/correlation yang benar. External effect memiliki outbox, retry dan reconciliation; webhook berulang/terlambat, response hilang dan partial failure teruji. Tidak mengklaim exactly-once universal untuk jaringan eksternal
remaining: The owner has not named the priority integrations for `id-idr` (payment, bank, tax filing).
The connector contract has no version field and no secret rotation test exists.
No run against a Midtrans sandbox exists; it needs a merchant account and a public HTTPS origin from the owner.
A mail provider run needs a mail provider account from the owner.

requirements.requirement: Import memvalidasi mapping, duplicate identity, opening balance dan control totals. Dry run, rollback/kompensasi yang sesuai serta rekonsiliasi source-to-target tersedia; data production tidak dipakai sebagai fixture uji
remaining: Import of organizations and parties with tax ids, and of open AR and AP documents with dates and terms, is absent.
No control-total check compares source totals with a declared opening, and no dry-run report reconciles source to target.
A real migration source from a pilot customer has not been imported.

requirements.requirement: Actor, tenant, entity, role, service account, independent approver dan revoke ditegakkan server. MFA/SSO/provisioning/offboarding wajib bila profil mensyaratkan; RLS lokal tidak dihitung sebagai bukti seluruh IAM enterprise
remaining: User and grant administration with audit is absent from the product (see UX-01).
The owner has not decided whether `id-idr` requires MFA or SSO; if it does, neither exists.
The unmaintained `paste` dependency (RUSTSEC-2024-0436) has no recorded owner review.
An enterprise IAM review needs an outside reviewer.

requirements.requirement: Owner memahami data apa yang dikirim ke provider. Knowledge/context field, retention, export/delete, audit dan residency mengikuti policy profil; secret tidak masuk prompt/log. Self-host backend tidak berarti inference selalu lokal; pilihan tanpa provider diuji bila ditawarkan
remaining: Retention, export and delete of agent conversations and goals per an owner policy are absent.
Arbitrary secrets typed into free text are not classified out of prompts.
The provider terms, retention and residency, and the Indonesian data-protection obligations, need a legal review by the owner before the policy is recorded per profile.

requirements.requirement: Backup terenkripsi, restore ke host bersih, upgrade/migration, audit/alert dan runbook diuji. Tetapkan serta ukur RTO/RPO; single-writer fencing bukan bukti HA, dan restore lokal bukan bukti disaster recovery produksi
remaining: No RTO or RPO target is recorded and the ops check reports no restore time or data age.
No test makes an alert fire or confirms a receiver, and the runbook has not been drilled end to end.
No production host is chosen, so a clean-host restore and a disaster-recovery drill cannot run; the owner chooses the host.
The upgrade proof from a previous package is not recorded for the current commit.

requirements.requirement: Sizing, workload, concurrency, data volume dan konfigurasi dikunci. Laporkan p50/p95, errors, saturation, recovery dan biaya; pertahankan target Commerce 50 ms yang masih terbuka sampai ada perubahan requirement beralasan dan tercatat
remaining: No mixed workload with finance reports and agent turns, and no saturation curve, exists.
The Commerce p95 target has not been re-run on the current source; its last records are from 2026-11-08.
Sizing, hardware and cost per workload need the production host chosen by the owner.

requirements.requirement: Each offered industry capability has a complete supported lifecycle, correction, negative authority, finance links and user evidence.
remaining: The owner has not named the offered industry profiles (the PRD suggests trade and project services).
Subscriptions, assets, accommodation, foodservice and laundry have no finance links, and none has an acceptance journey like the store finance cycle.
Pilot users have not produced evidence for any offered capability.

requirements.requirement: Owner dapat melihat current business profile, installed/enabled capabilities, configurable options, permissions yang ia miliki, dan kebutuhan yang belum tersedia. Menampilkan katalog tidak memberikan entitlement atau grants.
remaining: A business profile (the owner's description and the modules it implies) is not stored or shown.
Every module is `Ready`, so unmet needs (no book, no policy, no tax code) can never appear.
No browser check asserts the unmet-needs display, which cannot be produced yet.

requirements.requirement: Archava menanyakan hanya business details yang belum jelas, kemudian menghasilkan structured requirements. Jangan memaksa memilih satu label industri untuk bisnis hybrid atau meminta owner memahami crate/schema/env vars.
remaining: No question loop asks about unclear or missing details (for example whether a hotel serves food).
No model-backed proposer exists that outputs the same typed request with the same review.
Real owners' sentences, from pilot users, are not yet test data.

requirements.requirement: Backend menyusun immutable proposed configuration dari trusted catalogue dan current state. Dependency resolution, compatibility, permissions, data lifecycle, readiness dan pricing dievaluasi deterministik. LLM hanya mengusulkan structured input; tidak menjalankan schema edits atau arbitrary code.
remaining: No HTTP test asserts that forged `readiness`, `cost` and `price` fields on `/own/plan` are refused.
The catalogue has no incompatibility rule and no data-lifecycle rule, and no statement says none exists yet.
Readiness and pricing inputs are constants, so nothing real is evaluated.
No test pins a resource between plan and apply (item 14 of the owner test map).

requirements.requirement: Tampilkan dalam bahasa bisnis: apa yang ditambah/diubah, fitur/UI/workflows yang terdampak, dependencies, active records/jobs yang perlu diselesaikan, biaya implementasi/recurring/usage bila berlaku, perkiraan gangguan, dan recovery path. Missing price/readiness menjadi explicit unknown/review state.
remaining: The plan and screen do not state records and jobs to settle, expected disruption or the recovery path.
Cost has classes but no amounts, and no test shows the explicit `Review` or `NeedsSetup` state that the host never produces.
The preview names modules by id and has had no wording review.

requirements.requirement: Persetujuan terikat tenant/principal, operation, plan/input hash, base config revision, catalogue/release compatibility, pricing snapshot bila relevan, affected resources dan expiry. Tidak ada `approved: true` dari model/body yang dapat menggantikan server-verifiable approval.
remaining: A configuration plan and its confirmation have no expiry, so an old confirmation stays valid while the revision and catalogue are unchanged.
The approval has no keyed signature (the plan hash is FNV-1a) and the owner has not decided whether it needs one like the AI-sharing review.

requirements.requirement: Backend mengecek ulang current authority dan preconditions, mengklaim request idempotency, lalu menerapkan melalui supported transaction/job. Tampilkan progress/outcome dari authoritative backend. “Applied” hanya setelah actual runtime configuration/activation yang relevan terkonfirmasi.
remaining: No dated acceptance record names a commit for OWN-06 together with the full Rust gate and the browser gate that ran on it; acceptance needs one.

Every module in the host catalogue is entitled, installed, `Ready` and priced `included@1` (`crates/host/src/own.rs`), so no module needs setup or activation and "applied only after activation" is satisfied by an immediate toggle; acceptance needs a catalogue whose readiness and cost facts are not constants, or an owner decision that constants are the intended state of this release.

requirements.requirement: Setelah refresh, connection loss atau worker restart, owner dapat mengecek request yang sama tanpa double activation/charge. Unknown outcome direkonsiliasi sebelum retry. Current authority tetap diperiksa untuk status/replay.
remaining: No browser or process-level check applies an owner change, restarts the server and recovers the same receipt.
No browser check retries a pending id the server never committed and asserts one effect.

requirements.requirement: Tampilkan versi konfigurasi dan audit perubahan. Restore supported prior configuration membuat versi baru setelah compatibility check; tidak berarti mengembalikan seluruh database ke masa lalu atau membatalkan payment, stock, invoice, agreement dan pekerjaan bisnis yang sudah terjadi.
remaining: The browser check does not assert the history screen's rows (actor, outcome, revision, label changes).
No HTTP test blocks a restore whose target now violates a dependency, because the catalogue cannot yet be moved in a test.

acceptanceSuites.OWN-T01..OWN-T10: requires explicit mapped execution; existing own.rs and browser evidence are inputs, not automatic acceptance
acceptanceSuites.B01..B07: proposed protocols; require selected profiles and actual results

inheritedRequirements.note: Applicable inherited requirements must be mapped and accepted or explicitly superseded before whole-product completion.
